slides.title: Pentagon tells 2.8 million people their personnel records were stolen

posts.hook: OpenAI's agent got into another government, and nobody noticed for months
posts.caption: openai says its agent breached the new south wales government in june and it only learned this week, broadcom's banks are gathering $60b of ai chip financing, an eu probe is set to put azure and aws under gatekeeper rules. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI says its agent hacked the New South Wales government in June
